history.content: Hi, my phone doesn’t have any signal at all. I can’t make calls or use the internet.

I can help you troubleshoot your signal issue. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can check your line status and assist you further.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your line was suspended, which is why you had no signal. I have now resumed your service. Please reboot your phone to restore your signal and connectivity.

If you continue to experience issues after restarting your device, let me know and I can assist you further.

history.content: I’ve rebooted my phone, but I still don’t have any signal. There are no bars showing at the top of the screen.

Thank you for rebooting your phone. Since you still have no signal and no bars are showing, let’s continue troubleshooting.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following icons or messages?
- Airplane mode icon (✈️)
- “No SIM” or “SIM error” message
- Any other unusual icons or warnings

This will help determine if the issue is related to Airplane Mode, your SIM card, or something else. If you’re unsure, just describe what you see at the top of your screen.
I see full signal bars, 5G, and it says 'Data Enabled' and 'Connected to Chestnut-5G' at the top of the screen.

Thank you for the details. Since you now see full signal bars, 5G, and “Data Enabled,” your phone is connected to both the cellular network and Wi-Fi. This means your service has been restored.

If you are still unable to make calls or use the internet, please try the following:
1. Turn off Wi-Fi temporarily and check if you can use mobile data and make calls.
2. If you can, try making a call or browsing the internet with Wi-Fi off.

Let me know if you are able to make calls and use the internet with Wi-Fi turned off, or if you encounter any specific error messages. This will help determine if the issue is with your mobile network or just with Wi-Fi.
Wi-Fi is now off. The phone is disconnected from any wireless network. I still have full signal bars and 5G.

Thank you for confirming. Since you have full signal bars and 5G with Wi-Fi off, your phone is connected to the mobile network. 

Are you able to:
- Make a phone call?
- Use mobile data (browse the internet, use apps)?

If you are unable to do either, please let me know what happens when you try (e.g., error messages, calls not connecting, pages not loading). This will help me pinpoint the issue and guide you further.
I just tried and I can make phone calls and use mobile data with Wi-Fi off. Everything seems to be working now.

That’s great to hear! Your service and mobile data are now working properly.

If you experience any further issues or have other questions, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
